title: AI Agents for Sales & Support
shortDescription: They answer customers, qualify leads and resolve cases 24/7 — no waiting in line.
longDescription: We build digital workers that assist customers, qualify prospects, update your systems and escalate complex cases to your team, every day of the year.

title: Operational Process Automation
shortDescription: The repetitive work goes to the machine. What matters stays with your team.
longDescription: We find the manual tasks eating up hours — emails, forms, approvals, reports — and turn them into automated workflows that run on their own.

title: Assistants With Your Company's Knowledge
shortDescription: Your AI answers with YOUR information, not generic internet answers.
longDescription: We connect AI to your manuals, contracts, catalogs and internal data, so every answer to customers and teams is accurate and verifiable.

title: Process Diagnosis & Prioritization
shortDescription: Before automating, we measure exactly where time and money are being lost.
longDescription: We analyze response times, workload and customer behavior to pinpoint what to automate first and how much you stand to gain from it.

title: Integration With Your Current Systems
shortDescription: No replacing what already works: we plug AI into your WhatsApp, CRM and ERP.
longDescription: We integrate agents, data and automations with the tools your company already runs — WhatsApp, CRM, email, ERP, calendars, APIs and databases.

title: Custom Software & Platforms
shortDescription: When the solution doesn't exist yet, we build it from scratch.
longDescription: We design secure platforms, portals and internal tools with AI, integrations and cloud architecture built to grow with your business.
